# Maasai Amazing Safaris - Tanzania Safari & Travel Company

## About Us
Maasai Amazing Safaris is a premier Tanzania-based safari and travel company specializing in authentic African adventures. We offer expertly crafted safari experiences across Tanzania's Northern and Southern Circuits, Mount Kilimanjaro climbing expeditions, and Zanzibar beach holidays.

## Our Services

### Northern Circuit Safaris
- Serengeti National Park safaris
- Ngorongoro Crater tours
- Tarangire National Park experiences
- Lake Manyara wildlife viewing
- Great Migration witnessing (seasonal)
- Multi-day safari packages (3, 5, 7, and 8 days)

### Mount Kilimanjaro Climbs
- Machame Route (Whiskey Route) - 7 days
- Marangu Route (Coca-Cola Route) - 6 days
- Professional mountain guides
- Full equipment and support
- Success-focused acclimatization schedules

### Southern Circuit Safaris
- Nyerere National Park (formerly Selous)
- Ruaha National Park
- Mikumi National Park
- Udzungwa Mountains National Park
- Boat safaris on Rufiji River
- Walking safaris
- Off-the-beaten-path wilderness experiences

### Zanzibar Beach Holidays
- Stone Town historical tours
- Spice plantation visits
- Prison Island excursions
- Beach relaxation in Nungwi, Paje, and Kendwa
- Snorkeling and diving
- Jozani Forest Red Colobus monkeys
- 4, 5, 6, and 7-day packages available

### Combined Packages
- Bush to Beach experiences
- Safari + Kilimanjaro combinations
- Northern + Southern Circuit tours
- Custom itineraries

## Best Time to Visit
- Dry Season (June-October): Best for wildlife viewing
- Great Migration (June-July): Serengeti river crossings
- Green Season (November-May): Fewer tourists, beautiful landscapes
- Zanzibar: Year-round destination

## What We Offer
- 4x4 safari vehicles with pop-up roofs
- Professional English-speaking guides
- Park entrance fees included
- Full board accommodation
- Airport transfers
- Drinking water on safari
- Binoculars and field guides
- Emergency evacuation insurance
